description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
